items.title: To die (মারা যাওয়া)
items.body: To kick the bucket, To breathe one's last, To buy the farm, To cross the Styx, To give up the ghost, To hop the twig, To kiss the dust/ground, To bite the dust/ground, Pass away, To yield up the ghost, Pay the debt of nature, Cut off = To die = মারা যাওয়া, শেষ নিঃশ্বাস ত্যাগ করা।
items.topic: To die — মারা যাওয়া (kick the bucket, pass away…)

items.title: Sometimes / Occasionally (মাঝে মাঝে)
items.body: At times, Ever and anon, From time to time, Every so often, Every now and then/again, Now and again/then, Off and on, On occasion = Sometimes, occasionally = মাঝে মাঝে, মাঝে-মধ্যে
items.topic: Sometimes — মাঝে মাঝে (now and then, off and on…)
